page.layout: One column of running text. A marginal note stands in the left margin beside the line "D. An res uendita". Page number at the head, left. Running head at the head, decorative and illegible.

main_text.p: procuratoris, 5. §. sed si dedi, D.de trib.act. Lex est: Res le-gitimè uedita & tradita,em-ptoris esto. Vendidi domum Sempronio, eidemque tradi-di. Cum precium non soluis-set, aliusque maius offerret, repetere uolui. Intētio: Haec domus mea est. D. Imò mea. Q.utrius fit. R. Quia uendita mihi abs te,atque tradita est: F. At nec precii soluisti, nec eo nomine satisfecisti. D. An [illegible, ~6 letters]res uendita,quamuis tradita, tamen ante precium persolu-tum,emptoris non fit. Respõ-detur,non esse. d.L. quod uē-didi. D.de cont.empt. Con-stitutio de scripto nata est: pro-

page.notes: The left margin mark beside "D. An" is a printed flourish or small Hebrew-like form that I cannot read letter by letter; it is marked illegible. The running head is ornamental and not legible. "Intētio" and "Respõ" are as printed; the tilde on the vowel is read as a left-out n. The line "Respõ" / "detur" has no printed hyphen, so the word is written whole. Long s is plain s throughout.
